fullDescription: A sophisticated iOS-inspired Light Mode design system characterized by its use of glassmorphism, soft neutral backgrounds, and a semantic traffic-light color palette. This style is ideal for utility applications, fintech dashboards, smart home controls, and high-end SaaS settings pages. It leverages a clean Inter typography system with heavy-weighted headers and subtle capitalized labels to create a clear visual hierarchy. Key features include translucent blurred surfaces, custom iOS-style toggle switches, and grouped list layouts that provide a native mobile feel within a web environment.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-fidelity iOS Light Mode interface with glassmorphism elements, clean list-based settings groups, and a vibrant semantic color system for price tracking or utility monitoring.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system based on iOS 17+ light mode aesthetics. Background color: #f5f5f7. Surface color: #ffffff with 1px solid #e5e5ea borders. Use Inter as the primary font. Primary text: #1d1d1f, Secondary text: #86868b. Interaction accent: #276EF1. Semantic colors: Success (#10b981), Warning (#f97316), Error (#ef4444). Border radius: 12px for small components, 16px to 24px for large cards. Shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1). Glassmorphism: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) with backdrop-filter: blur(20px). Animations: 0.4s ease-in-out for toggle switches and 0.2s active state transitions.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Header
The header should be sticky with a background of #f5f5f7 at 80% opacity and 12px blur. Padding: top 56px, sides 20px, bottom 16px. It contains a small 12px uppercase label above a 28px bold h1 title. On the right, include a 44x44px circular profile image with a subtle #e5e5ea border.

### Grouped Settings Section
Organize settings into logical blocks. Each block starts with a 13px bold uppercase header in #86868b with 12px horizontal tracking. The content is wrapped in a #ffffff card with a 1px #e5e5ea border and 16px border-radius. List items inside are separated by 1px #e5e5ea dividers. Items consist of a 40x40px icon container (10% opacity background of the icon color), a text block with 15px bold primary text and 12px secondary text, and a toggle or chevron on the right.

### Custom Input Card
A special section for data entry. Inside a white card, include a horizontal layout with icon, text, and toggle. Below that, a nested #f5f5f7 input box with 12px padding. The input box should display a tiny uppercase label, a large 18px bold numeric value, and a static unit label (e.g., currency) on the far right.

### Information Card
A standout card for privacy or info notices. Background: white/60 with backdrop-filter blur. Padding: 20px. Includes a 48x48px circular icon with a thin 20% opacity border of the accent color. Text consists of a 15px bold heading and 13px leading-relaxed body text.

### Navigation Tab Bar
Fixed at the bottom with a 34px safe area padding. Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) with 20px blur and a 1px top border. Three tabs equally spaced. Each tab has a 22px icon and 10px bold uppercase label. Active tab color: #276EF1; Inactive: rgba(134, 134, 139, 0.6).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### iOS Native Toggle — Standard iOS style switch with smooth animations.
Design a 51x31px toggle switch. Track color: #e5e5ea (off), #34c759 (on). Thumb: 27x27px white circle with a shadow (0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)). Animation: 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) transition for both background color and thumb position (translate 20px).

### Interactive List Button — A button that looks like a list item with a hover state.
A full-width button with 16px padding. Left side: icon and text. Right side: secondary text and a light grey chevron-right. Interaction: Background changes to black/3% on active click.

style.description: The style is built on a neutral base of #f5f5f7 with pure white #ffffff surfaces and subtle #e5e5ea borders. It employs glassmorphism for top and bottom navigation bars (white/70 with 20px blur). Typography uses the Inter family, ranging from 10px uppercase labels to 28px bold titles. Semantic colors include Cheap Green (#10b981), Mid Orange (#f97316), and Expensive Red (#ef4444), with an Accent Blue (#276EF1) for interactive elements and brand presence. Micro-interactions include 400ms transitions on switches and active-state scaling on buttons.
